lines.english: Looking up, I see the same familiar sky. The same old sky I've seen for the past twenty years.
The same old sky that watches over the life I've built over the yearsーa life that has crumbled ever so slightly.
"Good morning! I'm Yanagihara Tomo from the news department. It's a pleasure to meet you!"
"Ah, are you the rumored Ms. Houjou? Everyone's calling you the rising star around here, you know?"
"No, that has nothing to do with my work here. I'm no more than a rookie around here. I'll probably make a lot of mistakes, but I hope you'll help me improve."
"Ah, you don't need to be so nervous. You're more serious than I thought you would be."
"Thank you very much. I'll do my best!"
"Haha, well, don't overdo it. Well then, I'll take you to the Managing Editor, so follow me."
"Yes, sir!"
"Always act humble on the outside, and when the chance comes, take the whole cake! That's my first step towards glory～♪"
"Well then, I'll be heading home for today. I'll have a new sample out first thing tomorrow."
"Ah, just a second! Hey, Iizuka-kun! Have you thought about what I told you earlier?"
"Ah, um, you told me something…?"
"Don't play dumb. I told you about the mixer, remember?"
"O-Oh, you mean that…"
"Iizuka-kun, ever since they put you in charge, you've risen so far up the ranks."
"So we think we should celebrate, go out, meet some people, and keep up the good work once we're back."
"Ah, well, I am happy with how the sales have risen, but I'm only doing what's expected of me."
"Don't be like that. There'll be some new faces there."
"New faces?"
"The girls in this one are quite cute, you know? You can pick and choose from underclassmen to high school graduates!"
"So we've gathered around five or six people. You can just see the whole thing as a friendly outing, rather than a corporate thing."
"…For real?"
"Yeah, it doesn't get more real than this. Iizuka-kun, you're from Houjou, right? Can't you pick up some people on your end?"
"Well, if you put it that way………
!? N-No, that's not what I meant. I suck at that kind of stuff, so let me off the hook, please!"
"Ah, Iizuka-kun!"
"See ya again tomorrow. Good work today!"
"Ah, hightailed it again… Seriously, that guy is on his guard like you wouldn't believe."
"I don't get it. He was a massive playboy in his school days, and yet…"
"I don't agree to this!"
"Calm down, Mizusawa-san."
"You can't just remove the sales course from the employee training! Especially not when the welcoming ceremony is already finished…
"Like I said, the company is short on staff this season. The other departments are demanding I send them more manpower ASAP.
"That doesn't matter, I'm just venting my bitterness. It's the sales course that's important here!"
"Yeah, about that…"
"Last year, it took all I had to pass that course. But in my opinion, that's what made it such a worthwhile effort in the end."
"Yeah, for many people it's their only opportunity to experience the real deal. The company of course understands the value in…"
"So getting rid of it makes absolutely no sense! Please try to negotiate with the guys at the top, boss! If you don't, I'll go there myself!"
"Is that the consensus among everyone?"
"Of course. I've gathered the opinions of all employees, including the managers."
"…And for some reason they chose you, a second-year employee, to represent them?"
"I don't mind taking up any role, that's why they chose me."
"Come to think of it, I seem to remember you wanting to move into development."
"Right now I don't mind any post. Be it development, business, working the store, or even HR. The path before me will open as long as I put in effort."
"…Seems like I've trained you to become quite the meddlesome one, in a single year, no less."
"I'm sorry, but I've been faking it a lot up until now. What you see here is the real me."
"How many times do I have to explain until you get it through your thick skull!?"
"Right back at you, Hamada-san! For once, I don't think I'm even slightly in the wrong here!"
"Ngh…"
"Don't grumble like that, Hamada-san. That's basically admitting defeat."
"Of course, doing things face-to-face is better than not, but even then there's a limit."
"But it becomes too businesslike otherwise. Magazines are written by people, so you need to convey some rawness in your reporting."
"I know, you're telling me that going out of one's way is good. I don't disagree with that. But right now I have other priorities that take precedence."
"Woah, did I just hear Macchan say something grown-up?"
"I get that I'm in my fourth year already… but right now I have to remain at the bottom."
"Oh dear."
"Alrighty then, I'll be right off to my project. I'll head home right after, so this'll be our farewell for today."
"…I'm sorry, but that's how things are. This time I really can't meet your standards, Hamada-san."
"Matsuoka."
"There aren't enough hands to go around, after all. I have to make do with what I have…"
"It's fine already. I'll leave this to your judgment. Come to me for advice only if you get stuck."
"Thank you very much."
"What?"
"Oh, nooothing."
"Good for you."
"Let's keep up the good work, Macchan."
"Obviously."
"Huh, you can't work overtime?"
"I'm sorry, not today."
"That's not good… I have a presentation at 10 o'clock on Monday, but we're a bit lacking in material…"
"How far along are you?"
"The only thing I've accomplished so far is to realize that I need to begin working on it soon."
"H-Haha…"
"Well, I suppose I could cook something up if I come to work on the weekend. But if there are two of us, we could finish it today."
"I-I see…"
"You really can't?"
"Today's kind of…"
"Even if I beg?"
"…I'm sorry."
"…Boyfriend?"
"…I'm so terribly sorry!"
"God dammit! Inseparable as always, you two!"
"We have plans for dinner today so… I'm sorry."
"I bet it won't end there. You're going to stay at your boyfriend's place both today and tomorrow, aren't you?"
"I only do that sometimes… Only once every two weeks."
"In other words, on top of always forcing your junior to listen to you ramble on about your boyfriend, you're also going to refuse working on the weekends."
"Um, send me everything you've finished so far by email. I'll take the early Monday shift and get it done for you."
"…Eh, forget about it."
"I promise I'll get it done by 10 o'clock on Monday!"
"That's not what I meant… It's my fault for slacking off in the first place, and I don't wanna spoil your day when you're so happy."
"…I really am sorry."
"I said forget about it. I've resolved myself to work the weekend. I'll head home for today. Want to go to the station together?"
"Ah, okay."
"So anyway, lemme hear about your boyfriend. It'll make for good material to taunt all the guys who have their sights on you, Ogiso-chan."
"Huh? But it's nothing but a bunch of boring stuff. We've been dating for ages already."
"I can think of five guys who'd have their worlds fall apart if they heard you say that."
It's April.
Two springs ago I graduated university, and for two springs I have worked for my current company.
A friend burning with hope, in a new place to belong. A friend who never broke the oath that we swore last spring.
And…
Like that, each friend walks their own path.
This is the story of that spring, all the way until autumn.
From the end of winter, to the beginning of the next…
Another story beginning with the melting of the snow, and ending with its fall once again.
"I'm home."
When I open the front door, silence and darkness greet me.
Without switching on the light, I simply walk into the dark room after taking off my high-heels.
I follow the wall toward the bedroom door, then turn on the night lamp by the entrance.
"A senior at work had me all tied up. For a moment there, I was wondering if I'd ever make it home today."
Within the murky darkness of the room, no signs of life can be seen.
The only proof that he lives here is…
…The days worth of old clothes and underwear littered all over the room.
The better someone knows this guy, the more surprised they'd be at the state this place is in.
Although, any somewhat lazy person might not find anything out of the ordinary here.
"I'm sorry, this might get a bit loud."
After picking up the clothes abandoned on the floor, I put them into the washing machine and turn it on.
"Do you have anything else dirty? Are the ones you're wearing okay?"
I glance at the human-sized bulge on the bed, hidden beneath the sheets.
And then his head, the only part of him that's uncovered, gives the slightest hint of a nod.
"Did you get any sleep today?"
No response this time.
"I see… Did you take your medicine?"
Once again, a tiny movement.
"Can you eat today?"
A tiny movement once again, but this time in a different direction.
"I'll make something that'll last then. I'll leave it here when it's ready, so just ding it when you feel hungry."
When I turn on the kitchen lamp, the whole place becomes ever so slightly brighter.
One by one, I line up all the ingredients from my shopping bag.
"…Oh, I said 'ding it' again, didn't I? I just can't seem to drop this habit of mine, hehe."
This is what my weekends are like.
To him… to Haruki-kun, this might just be a day like any other. Just one out of 365 others.
But to me, these moments are that of pure happiness and bliss.
It is the end of February.
When the curtains fell on Kazusa's legendary concert that day, those same curtains also fell on her final days in Japan.
That day, I left this person's side.
When he confessed everything to me, I couldn't bring myself to forgive the things he did with Kazusa, his feelings, his love for her.
And for the next week…
For seven whole days, I ran away from the world surrounding me.
I weeped with the same regret as five years ago. I screamed at my own failure, so much worse than anything I did five years ago.
And finally, I came back to this apartment.
"I don't want to sound arrogant, but I think this stew turned out pretty well. I even had seconds, twice!"
When I once again stepped foot in this place, Haruki-kun was still running away from the world, just like I had been the day prior.
And his flight is still continuing to this day.
"…Although now my belly feels a bit heavy. I'll probably have to take some stomach medicine later."
Thankfully, Kaiousha took Haruki's side.
After an interview with an occupational health physician, they determined that his condition was partly due to "stress from unjust overwork"
"Come to think of it, it's almost time for March's new music release. Tomo hasn't talked to me the past month, so I completely forgot about it."
Nowadays, he only goes outside once a week, and that's only to visit the psychiatric hospital.
…All the other days are spent here, in this apartment.
"Apparently she fulfilled her wish to work in a news department. I wonder what backhanded tricks she used this time."
During some weeks he finds himself completely unable to get out of bed, and during others he can't fall asleep at all.
"Come to think of it, Takeya-kun and Io said they wanted to visit you sometime soon."
When he can't get up, I don't force him up.
Because he never got any decent sleep since his graduation from university.
"I keep telling them there's no need to worry so much. You'll get better soon anyway, and then we'll be able to see each other every month like always."
During the weeks when he can't get any sleep, I don't say anything.
Because I know just how badly he wants to fall asleep himself.
I know just how deeply he's suffering, after being abandoned all alone in the real world.
…I know that he's desperately trying to forget about everything and just return to his dream world.
"Fuaah… I feel kinda sleepy… Perhaps I really did eat too much."
I don't have the courage, nor the right…
…To know what, or who, is waiting for him in that world.
"…Setsuna."
"Hm?"
"Setsuna, you don't have to come here anymore."
"Hmm…"
Those were the first words… that Haruki-kun said to me today.
"Enough with this already…"
Those are words he's desperately forcing out of himself, words that signify that he has me on his mind.
"I'll live with the person I am for the rest of my life. I've prepared myself for that."
It makes me happy.
"But that doesn't mean I can allow you to get mixed up in my stagnant life."
"Yeah yeah, let's talk about that next time."
"Stop running away and listen to me, Setsuna…"
"I'm not messing around, and I'm not running away either… I'm not running away at all…"
His trembling reaches me through his cheek and our entwined hand.
"It's just that… I want to talk about this when you're feeling better, Haruki-kun. When you can talk to me calmly. Okay?"
"And when would that be? When in the world would that be…?"
"Someday. But I promise the day will come."
"That's a lie. I'll stay like this for the rest of my life."
"In any case, there's no need to rush for an answer. We can take it slowly. Rest for today, okay?"
I want to wrap myself around him with all my might, and I want to console him with powerful words.
"Besides, you've been rushing far too much up until now, Haruki-kun. No one would blame you for taking it a bit slow for once, you know?"
"That has nothing to do with this…"
But I can't do either of those things right now.
"I didn't turn out like this because I overworked myself at the office. This has nothing to do with rushing through life."
So instead, I embrace him softly, slowly and silently.
"You should know that better than anyone, Setsuna…"
"The one who pushed you to this point was me, five years ago."
However, my body temperature isn't enough to do away with the coldness in his heart.
"…You should know that better than anyone."
"There is no forgiving what I did, and you're the last person in the world who should be forgiving me, Setsuna."
"Haruki-kun…"
Because even now, he won't stop hurting himself. He won't stop rejecting himself.
"So you don't have to come here anymore… Just leave me be."
Even though he's wrong.
The reason I'm with you right now isn't because of any noble feelings on my part.
"Just abandon me already."
It's neither sympathy nor forgiveness that's driving me to do this…
"Leave me alone…"
"Haruki-kun, I'm…"
"…I'm sorry, that was a lie."
"Huh?"
But in the end, it wasn't my rejection of myself that put an end to his grief…
"I'm lying to you."
"Haruki-kun…?"
"Of course you have to stay… Without you, Setsuna, I wouldn't know what to do with myself."
"Ah…"
It was an even greater source of grief that put a stop to it.
"If I really wanted you gone, I could've just used the door chain to lock you out. I could just chase you out even now."
The feelings of guilt he bears toward me won't ever be washed away, no matter what anyone tells him.
"Yet I did neither of those things. I never took away the apartment key from you, nor did I ever lock the door with the chain."
"Thank you, for giving me another chance."
That's why his heart only falls deeper into despair when I'm by him.
"You did my laundry, you cooked for me, you embraced me… I can finally admit this, now that I feel so fulfilled."
"I feel fulfilled too. We're even."
"It doesn't end there. When I noticed you were a little bit late, it felt as if my body was getting torn apart."
"…I'm sorry for breaking my promise."
But right now, he has to rely on the very person who is nothing but poison to him.
"I was worried out of my mind that… perhaps, you had finally decided to stop coming… That you had abandoned me."
"Haruki-kun…"
"I'm despicable. I'm such a despicable person…"
And I…
"No, it makes me happy… It makes me so happy."
I can't bring myself to leave his side. I can't bring myself to stop breaking him.
"I can't bear the thought of tormenting you, yet I can't bear the thought of a reality without you either."
I can't stop the ugliness within myself from feeling a dark sense of joy from his laments.
"I can't head in either direction. I can't decide anything. The world has no use for a man like me!"
I can't stop the patheticness within myself from feeling affection toward him, but only when he clings to me.
"Most importantly, you have no use for me, Setsuna… No, I'm nothing but a source of pain for you."
"That's not true. That's not true at all…"
"I'm sorry. I'm so sorry… Uu, uugh, uuug… Uuaah…"
"Haruki-kun… Everything's okay, Haruki-kun."
Not so I can save him, but to satisfy my own desires.
"S-Setsuna… Uah, aah… kh… uuua…"
"I won't ever leave you, and I promise you'll get better…!"
All I want to do… is to convince myself that the past two years weren't for nothing… when I won only because my opponent withdrew.
"Mh…"
I let out a big yawn with my eyes on the bright sky. The clock is nearing 10 o'clock.
He cried all night, but he finally exhausted himself by early dawn, and finally fell asleep.
After a few hours of gazing at his sleeping face, I quietly slipped out of the apartment.
After all, my presence this week seems to have had a bad effect on him.
Most likely, Haruki-kun won't wake up for a day or two.
But when he does wake up, he'll probably be a good deal calmer than he was earlier.
The only thing it takes… is for me to not be around.
I was nothing but poison to him today.
I can only numb the pain for a short while, and the terrible side-effects I cause make me completely useless.
"Ah, good morning. Were you awake already?"
"No, I'm calling about the work you told me about yesterday. I'll come to the office today and do it."
"Yeah, that's how it is. I got into a big fight with my boyfriend last night so… haha."
